periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline, sloping downwards toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an oval, vertically elongated geometry with a height significantly exceeding the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches display a pronounced teardrop-like tapering, with the lowest point extending well below the geometric center of the black region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ear regions are positioned laterally with a wide separation gap approximately equal to twice the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior edges of the pinnae show a smooth, semi-circular curvature without any visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: The fur on the sub-mandibular and neck region displays a notably long, shaggy texture compared to the shorter fur on the cranial dome.
